title: feat(subscriptions): apply a plan change from the billing webhook
description: The billing provider sends `plan.changed` when a customer upgrades or downgrades. Adds `applyPlanChange`, which returns the subscription with the plan and seats of the event.
rationale: `event.plan` is a free `string` from a webhook and `Subscription.plan` is the closed union `Plan`: `as any` silences that error instead of narrowing, so an unknown plan is stored and `monthlyPrice` returns `NaN` for it.
